stepDefinitionReview.scope: Read-only review of git diff 9ad39030..f129bbfb in tests/bdd (support/s1-ui.ts, support/world.ts, new features/thread-menu.feature and steps/thread-menu.steps.ts) and of the product files they exercise (left-sidebar.tsx, thread-registry-store.ts, components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx, alert-dialog.tsx, pglite/client.ts, session-configuration/domain.ts, combobox-picker.tsx).
findings: No existing assertion was weakened. The changed helpers add waits or checks: renameActiveThread now waits for a stable title and for the dialog to close; captureReply waits for data-status=running to clear and for two equal reads; switchAgentViaUI clicks the list item and requires the agent-config GET (404 tolerated) and POST to answer below 400, the list to close and the trigger to show the agent; optionState scans a virtual list before reporting absent. No feature, oracle, fixture or frozen file changed.

No ambiguous step: no duplicate step text across tests/bdd/steps; the {string} expressions are anchored, so "the thread list shows {string}" cannot match the "… exactly once" text. The only regex step (live-model-choice.steps.ts:695) does not overlap.

Dead menu: Base UI Menu.Item (dropdown-menu.tsx:2,84) has no onSelect, so onSelect at f2c9e36/9ad39030 never fires. SCN-THR-001 then fails at "choosing Rename opens the rename dialog" and SCN-THR-002 fails at the Rename setup (this thread is named); both cancel controls fail the same way. A dead Delete with a live Rename would be caught by SCN-THR-002 itself at "choosing Delete asks for confirmation", but not by neg-thr-002 (disclosed limit 13).

No false pass found on persistence: setTitle/removeThread now return the PGlite query; PGlite.create("idb://uar-threads") sets no relaxedDurability, so the query resolves after the IndexedDB sync; AlertDialogAction is a plain Button, so the confirmation closes only after the await; the reload step waits for aria-busy=false before absence is asserted; messages cascade on delete (migrations.ts:18,32).

MEDIUM (residual, disclosed as limit 14): stableThreadTitle accepts two equal reads 1 s apart, so it can settle on the placeholder "New conversation" if /api/generate-title takes over about 1 s; the generated title then overwrites the rename (use-chat-runtime.ts:160-164) and SCN-THR-001 or an S1 scenario that renames fails. That is a false FAIL, not a false pass.
LOW: conversationText counts text in opacity-0 and clipped (sr-only) elements, like innerText did, and now also content-visibility-skipped text, as intended.

LOW: revealOption allows up to 400 scroll steps of at least 250 ms; an absent option in a long filtered virtual list could approach the 120 s test timeout. That is a timeout failure, not a false absent.

LOW (product, not a gate): Stop is shown but inert between setTurnBusy(true) and beginStream (local history load and draft persistence, chat-stream-store.ts:740-820); a rejected delete write closes the dialog silently and leaves an unhandled rejection; use-thread-graph-sync.ts ignores the new promises.
